native87_regression.cause: WindowsIntel32e uses 45-bit physical extraction; native generic 52-bit/ISF transition extraction retained software PFN flags and rejected ten readable file name pointers. Native88 full-field and emitted-sequence default passes without filtering.

captured_table_validation.scope: Actual WindowsIntel/WindowsIntelPAE/WindowsIntel32e mapping and translation over full synthetic page-table bytes, plus direct translation, one-byte reads and patterned 32-byte reads across 4 KiB boundaries. Physical BufferDataLayer subclass models explicit backing holes. Full default virtual range length excludes maximum_address. Covers contiguous/discontiguous PFNs, missing tables and backing tails, uniform tables, transition/prototype flags, uppermost page, large pages/PAT, reserved PFN bits, transition large pages, noncanonical input aliases, contiguous mappings across the x64 canonical midpoint and PAE root/physical-bit limits and Windows x64 45-bit PFN/software-flag behavior. Does not certify container mapping/decompression, all malformed reserved PFNs, all architectures or complete scan fault reporting.
captured_table_validation.implementation: Intel captured table walks validate a complete 4 KiB table and reject uniformly repeated entries; ordinary translation, prototype lookup, physical part of pagefile traversal and absent-page hints share that gate. A bounded validity LRU caches successes and failures; ARM64 table behavior remains separate. Reads permit the last native-domain byte without unsigned overflow.
